name: strategy-labs-plugins
description: Official plugin marketplace from Strategy Labs — boutique performance marketing tools for eCommerce and lead generation brands.

plugins.name: brand-content-os
plugins.description: Brand & Content Operating System — capture brand knowledge, enforce voice consistency, and generate on-brand content across paid ads, email, SMS, Shopify, and social channels. Includes Fast.io team sync and organized output directories.

plugins.name: customer-driven-optimizations
plugins.description: Analyze recorded customer phone calls to extract competitive intelligence, identify site optimization opportunities, map customer journeys, and generate a deployable HTML dashboard. Supports both audio files and pre-made transcripts. Integrates with Brand Content OS for brand context. Includes frontend-design skill for production-grade dashboard UI.

plugins.name: competitive-landscape
plugins.description: Track competitors, analyze their ad strategies across Meta and Google, map customer journeys on competitor sites, and generate competitive intelligence reports and deployable dashboards.

plugins.name: local-business-marketing-os
plugins.description: Full marketing operating system for local restaurants and hospitality businesses. Includes brand onboarding, review responses, email/SMS campaigns, weekly social content briefs, digital asset organization, and inbox management.

plugins.name: brand-knowledge-center
plugins.description: Brand Knowledge Center — a step-by-step setup wizard that builds a comprehensive brand profile covering business fundamentals, financials, digital presence, brand identity, audience messaging, and competitive landscape. Generates a structured brand-knowledge-center/ folder that serves as the foundation for all Strategy Labs marketplace plugins.

plugins.name: brand-asset-manager
plugins.description: Brand Asset Manager — organize, rename, describe, and catalog brand photos and videos into a searchable folder structure. Analyzes each asset, generates descriptions, suggests channel usage, flags duplicates, and maintains a searchable manifest. Integrates with Brand Knowledge Center for brand-aware categorization.

plugins.name: lead-list-builder
plugins.description: Lead List Builder — research and generate targeted lead lists, draft personalized outreach, track lead status, and deploy interactive dashboards. Uses web research to find leads by type, title, geography, and industry. Integrates with Brand Knowledge Center for brand-aware prospecting.
